description: This source file defines a static factory class for creating web driver instances (for Chrome and Firefox) in a Selenium-based testing framework, with options for headless operation and discovery mode.

classes.name: WebDriverFactory
classes.description: A static class responsible for creating WebDriver instances for specified browsers, considering discovery mode and headless options.

methods.name: CreateIfEnabled
methods.description: Creates and returns an IWebDriver for the configured browser unless discovery mode is enabled, in which case it returns null.

methods.name: CreateChrome
methods.description: Creates a ChromeDriver with specified options, including headless mode and window configurations.

methods.name: CreateFirefox
methods.description: Creates a FirefoxDriver with specified options, including headless mode.
